senses.text: alphabetical letter The twenty-third letter of the alphabet; called laAmN . It is one of the letters termed majohuwrap , or vocal, and also belongs to the class of AlHuruwfu Al*~uloqu , or *awolaqiy~ap , i. e. letters pronounced by means of the tip of the tongue and the lip; it is one of the letters of augmentation. -A2- As a numeral it denotes thirty. -A3- For the particles lA li la , &c., see Supplement.
